PX13-03.name: The FlowerQueen Cattleya
PX13-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All Spirits can't activate their (When Attacks) effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would be returned to the Hand/Deck by an opposing effect, it remains the the Field, refreshed.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP.

PX13-01.name: The FlameSaintBeast Ignis-Tiger
PX13-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Main Step)
Neither player can add cores from the Void.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would be returned to the Hand/Deck due to opposing effects, it remains on the Field, refreshed.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy two opposing 3000 BP or less Spirits.

PX13-05.name: The HellEmperor Hadeus
PX13-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Neither player's Spirits can refresh.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would be returned to the Hand/Deck due to opposing effects, it remains on the Field, refreshed.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.

PX13-02.name: The HornBushin Neptune-Kaishin
PX13-02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Attacks from Spirits with "can't be blocked" effects can't reduce either player's life.

[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would be returned to the Hand or Deck due to opposing effects, it remains on the field, refreshed.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

PX13-04.name: The SilverWolfOfficial By-Rean
PX13-04.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Neither player can summon Spirits without paying the cost via effects/Burst effects.

[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would be returned to the Hand/Deck due to opposing effects, it remains on the Field, refreshed.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.
